purpose: Teach: 馳せ/繰り出し/ベター/つぶす/まわす/喰い/飛び込む/おこない

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが故郷に思いを馳せていらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was lost in thought about his hometown.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost to herself. Warm and knowing. A quiet moment of noticing something tender about the people she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが繰り出しの式典に出られたんだって
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa got to go to the dedication ceremony.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact report, but with the small brightness of someone sharing something that mattered to someone else. Natural pace. No inflation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、宿題と遊び、両方やる方がベターよ
lines.en: Sho, it's better to do both your homework and have time to play.
lines.style: Practical guidance, not lecturing. The tone of someone who has thought about this before and is offering it gently. Even-paced, clear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、宿題を一気につぶす計画なんだ
lines.en: Mom, I have a plan to finish all my homework at once.
lines.style: Quiet determination. A small boy working through his strategy out loud. Not boasting—just stating his plan. Steady, self-assured in a six-year-old way.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、傘をくるくるまわすの止めてね
lines.en: Sho, please stop spinning your umbrella around like that.
lines.style: Firm but affectionate. A mother catching a small distraction in the moment. Not angry. Direct, with the undertone of 'I see what you're doing.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが鳥が虫を喰いに来てたって仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa said he saw birds coming to eat the bugs.
lines.style: Sharing an observation like it's important. Quiet wonder underneath. The voice of someone noticing what adults teach him to notice. Slight wonder at the small alive thing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達のお家のプールに飛び込むのは気を付けてね
lines.en: Sho, be careful if you jump into your friend's pool, all right?
lines.style: Protective but not anxious. A mother checking a safety box. Warm, matter-of-fact. The care underneath the practical words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんはおこないが立派な方だったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa was such a fine and honorable person.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. A child processing something larger than himself about someone he loved. Slow, careful with the words. Small weight in his voice.
